sentences.text: Kerberosaurus manakini was an extinct ornithopod hadrosaur that lived about 66 million years ago in the Upper Cretaceous of Russia.
This dinosaur is distinguished by narrow frontals, a unique braincase shape, and a distinct separation between the bone around the nostrils and the surrounding bone.
The animal is estimated to have reached a length of about 8 meters.
A large bonebed containing Kerberosaurus fossils was discovered in 1984 by Yuri Bolotsky and the Amur Complex Integrated Research Institute.
It was a large herbivore that ate plants using complex dental batteries.
Kerberosaurus is classified within the family Hadrosauridae and the subfamily Saurolophinae.
Cladistic analysis places Kerberosaurus as the sister taxon to the genera Saurolophus and Prosaurolophus.
The fossil record for Kerberosaurus spans the Maastrichtian stage from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
In 2014, Xing et al. proposed that Kundurosaurus nagornyi is a junior synonym of Kerberosaurus manakini based on shared skeletal characters and occurrence in the same formation.
